svg.title: Complete Daptin feature map
svg.desc: Eight groups summarize Daptin features: schema and data, APIs and discovery, identity and permissions, actions and orchestration, files sites and templates, realtime and protocols, integrations and LLMs, and metering and operations.

g.text: APPLICATION SERVER FEATURE MAP
The full backend surface—not just generated CRUD.
FOUNDATION
Schema & data runtime
• YAML or JSON schema stored in world metadata
• 41 column types · relations · joins · composite keys · default ordering
• validations · conformations · translations · standard columns
• audit/state/metering flags · import/export · random data generation
DELIVERY
APIs & discovery
• JSON:API CRUD · relationships · filtering · sorting · pagination
• aggregation API · optional GraphQL queries, mutations, actions
• /openapi.yaml · /meta · /jsmodel/{typename}
• asset, feed, action, state, integration, config, ping, statistics routes
POLICY
Identity & permissions
• users · usergroups · ownership · default/access groups
• table, row, relation, and action permission gates
• signup/signin · JWT sessions · reset flows · OTP/2FA
• OAuth consumer with PKCE · OAuth 2/OIDC provider + JWKS
ORCHESTRATION
Actions, tasks & state tracking
• action inputs · validation · conformation · conditions · ordered outcomes
• CRUD outcomes · Go performers · client responses · chained steps
• cron tasks execute any action as a selected user in a transaction
• smd definitions · generated state tables · transition audit · data exchange
CONTENT
Files, sites & templates
• encrypted credentials · rclone-backed local/cloud stores
• asset columns · uploads · multipart/presigned flows · direct serving
• ETag · gzip · memory/client/negative cache · storage sync tasks
• sites/subsites · host/path routing · Go templates · routed responses
SERVICES
Realtime & built-in protocols
• CRUD create/update/delete events → Olric PubSub → /live WebSocket
• topic permissions · publish action · optional YJS collaboration
• streams · RSS/Atom/JSON feeds · HTTP/HTTPS · TLS certificates
• SMTP + IMAP · FTP/FTPS · WebDAV-style CalDAV/CardDAV routes
PROVIDERS
Integrations & LLM routing
• install OpenAPI v2/v3 operations as Daptin actions
• REST · GraphQL · short-lived WebSocket · unary gRPC transports
• OAuth token or custom credential execution boundaries
• multi-provider LLM models · chat/SSE · completion · embedding · tools
OPERATIONS
Metering, clustering & operations
• plans · memberships · usage events · quota counters · credit hooks
• meter CRUD, actions, and LLM tokens · global and plan rate limits
• Olric cache/PubSub/counters · multi-node discovery · outbox dedupe
• /ping · /statistics · /_config · audit · logs · profiles · TLS
DATABASES: SQLITE · POSTGRESQL · MYSQL/MARIADB
SHARED RUNTIME CONFIGURATION · DATA-MANAGED CAPABILITIES
